description: Fail a project whose dependency graphs break a codependix boundary rule charged to it, built over the project and its Nx dependencies.

configurationPath.description: Path to the codependix configuration file, relative to the workspace root. The path this plugin is registered with in nx.json when omitted.

dependencies.description: Build the graphs over the judged projects' Nx dependency closure. False builds over the judged projects alone.

projects.description: Nx project names to judge, replacing the project this target belongs to.

tags.description: Nx project tags to judge, selecting every project carrying ANY of them.

title: Codependix gate
